The actual archetype carries `alternatives`, lenses use keys `build/fifa/path/role/style`, and radar data lives under `age_profile_reference`. Don't treat those 3 as regressions.
rca of the issue: ReportPage.jsx had a stray `*/` on line 1399 (a multi-line comment opener `/*` for AgeProfileCard was removed during the iter12 refactor but the closing `*/` was left behind). Babel parser threw 'Missing semicolon (1399:7)'. CRA dev server showed a red overlay and refused to render anything — every Playwright assertion failed at the email-input wait step. Fix: restore the comment block `/* AgeProfileCard — European academy reference overlay. Pure server-side enrichment, no AI involved. */`. HMR recompiled successfully in ~12s and all subsequent UI selectors resolved.
